item.title: [IGNITE-981] NPE in GridDhtPartitionDemandPool
item.description:
I use following scenario (in IDEA):
1. Start node via ExampleNodeStartup
2. Start node via CacheClientDiscoStartStopCacheExample (see attached files). It starts server node and then creates and drops the cache in loop.
3. Start node via CacheClientDiscoStartStopClientNodeExample (see attached files). It starts and stops client node in loop.
